card.name: Digits inside dose amounts in mcg
card.fires_on: A digit inside a multi-digit dose number, often the final 0 or a middle digit, just before mcg or mg. It appears in dosing sections for nasal sprays, implants and vaginal products.

modes.label: Dose digit before mg
modes.description: A digit or the word of right after a milligram amount for a suppository or IUD.

card.writes: It seems to suppress powder and tablet words, so the amount is followed by a unit and drug name, not a dosage form.
card.plain: It fires on the digits in a dose amount like 50 mcg or 200 mg, in dosing instructions for sprays, implants and suppositories.
